g.text: Share of recorded reef-nights within site
Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database v1.
One count per subsite-date; named sites may contain several subsites. Years panel shows actual years with recorded events.
A pale cell means few or no recorded events. Unknown survey effort prevents interpreting it as biological absence.
34 sites with at least five recorded reef-nights, ordered north to south
